title: Office Furniture Remodel
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE NAVY.NAVSEA.NAVSEA SHIPYARD.NORFOLK NAVAL SHIPYARD GF
detail_text: This is a Presolicitation Notice issued in accordance with Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) 5.201 by the Naval Sea Systems Command (NAVSEA), Norfolk Naval Shipyard (NNSY), Portsmouth, Virginia. The Government intends to issue a Request for Quote (RFQ) N4215826QS009 for the purchase and installation of office furniture to support the NNSY Contracting Office. The contractor shall furnish all labor, materials, equipment, and supervision necessary to deliver and install the required office furniture in accordance with the specifications that will be included in the solicitation. The anticipated Period of Performance start date is 01 June 2026 . This procurement will be solicited as a 100% Small Business Set‑Aside under NAICS 337214 . The RFQ will be available for download on or about March 17, 2026 , at https://sam.gov under solicitation number N4215826QS009 . The Government will not issue hard‑copy solicitations. All amendments will be posted electronically to SAM.gov, and it is the responsibility of interested vendors to monitor the website for updates. THE SOLICITATION IS NOT YET AVAILABLE. This notice serves solely to inform potential offerors of an upcoming opportunity; no quotes are being accepted at this time. Registrations: System for Award Management (SAM)-Offerors shall maintain an active registration in the SAM database at https://sam.gov to be eligible for a Government contract award
